wet_rei_send_return = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      wet_rei_return_target = yes
      OR = {
        has_country_flag = wet_rei_return_subsidy
        AND = {
          NOT = {
            has_country_flag = wet_rei_return_attempted
          }
          A01 = {
            has_completed_focus = WET_REI_R02
          }
        }
        A01 = {
          has_political_power
          >
          24
        }
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_rei_offer_return
      }
      check_variable = {
        wet_rei_offer_return_cooldown
        <
        1
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_rei_offer_return
    set_variable = {
      wet_rei_offer_return_days = 30
    }
    set_variable = {
      wet_rei_offer_return_cooldown = 180
    }
    A01 = {
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            is_in_array = {
              wet_rei_active_recipients = PREV
            }
          }
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_rei_active_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
    country_event = {
      id = wet_reikland.100
    }
  }
}
